important_discoveries: Audit (2026-09-26) verdict C; the 20 findings are AUD-01..AUD-20 on CRITICAL_FIXES, each linked to fix tasks.
Tracker formulas are verified by tools/tracker/excel_recalc.py against values computed from MASTER, not only for errors.
Repository fixtures are python-docx generated; Word-authored fixtures (audit a01-a12, r01-r05) are outside the repo (TEST-020).
scripts/e2e_server.py leaves %TEMP%/smartdoc-e2e-* dirs (TEST-006).
Docker daemon is not running on this machine; image builds are unverified locally (INFRA-010).
Excel/Word on this machine stamp MSIP_Label_* (tenant SiteId) into Office files on save; tracker.py and excel_recalc.py strip them, the pre-push scan flags them.
Editor schema (probe via getSchema(editorExtensions)): attribute-level drops remain for pasted textAlign, image width/height, link title, cell align/colwidth -> EDIT-008..011.
PDF export: a page break inside a table cell cannot be honoured (dropped there) - to report via FID-003.

Content check calibration on 17 Word-authored + 12 golden fixtures: all verified except a03 (heading numbers baked into text - genuine, AUD-04); a05 header variants lost is reported via header/footer check.
The browser preview tool is bound to the session's original folder (Claude - SGD): its .claude/launch.json got smartdoc-*-throwaway entries (untracked there).
One E2E run pasted at the document start (caret not yet placed by an early click); the test now checks focus and uses Ctrl+End.

Export read-back calibration: DOCX exports hold exactly the document's words on all 29 fixtures; PDF exports on all but a11-multilingual (Arabic unshaped/reversed, CJK and Devanagari missing - AUD-17), now reported at every export.

Section break type (w:type) belongs to the section it starts (ECMA-376 17.6.22): the importer used the ending section's type, so continuous breaks became page breaks - fixed, pinned by test_docx_detect.
Golden JSON export was non-deterministic (random uuids/timestamps): every regeneration rewrote all fixtures; now uuid5-by-order + fixed times.
Pasting into an empty paragraph poured the first pasted paragraph into it and dropped its attributes (ProseMirror fit) - fixed by pasteIntoEmptyBlock.ts.
Rule values were written into CSS unchecked (element style, page settings, AI instructions): SEC-022, fixed with formatting/values.py.
AppliedStyle's style attr is copied on split (a paragraph after a heading looked like the heading until reload): the editor now re-syncs block styles after each save.
Opening a document caused a save when a run had several marks: the editor lists marks in its schema order. Fixed with one canonical order (EDIT-007).
Pasted Markdown pictures (and their descriptions) vanished while the content check said verified: now named as left out (FID-006).
The old AI structure check (bag of words, 20% unknown allowed) passed sentence deletions, 'not' removal and 5->50 (AUD-02); replaced by text_check.check_text.
apply_formatting rebuilt the rules after instruction operations and dropped a style set on one element ('Applied 1 change', nothing changed); operations now apply after it.
The E2E server has a scripted AI (scripts/e2e_ai.py) answering two fixed instructions; everything else behaves as if no key.
A structure answer could store any documentType string, heading level 99 or a code language with quotes; AI answer fields are now bounded in ai/schemas.py (the SDK validates locally).
Word exports of imported documents are now written into the original package (only the body regenerated); the import report and capability matrix say what that keeps.
python-docx's add_comment references an undefined CommentReference style; exports now define the comment styles (found by the new package check).
